source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
Some cards add conditions after a normal condition:

- A 'cumulative' condition: achieving it scores its VP plus the normal condition's VP.
- 1 or more 'or' conditions: you can score VP for only 1 of them or the normal condition.

detail.cumulative: VP for both the cumulative and the normal condition
detail.or: VP for only one of the 'or' conditions or the normal condition
